title: Playing with Percy Humphrey and George Lewis, and the High Society incident
summary: He recalls early-1950s jobs with Percy Humphrey's band and a night when a requested High Society was followed by a guest's death.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
